title: 1. What is authorization?
summary: Authorization determines what an authenticated user is allowed to access or perform. Example: Three users log in to your AI application: User Allowed action --- --- Admin Manage users and view reports Manager View team reports Employee View own records All three users are authenticated, but their permissions are…

sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
Authorization determines what an authenticated user is allowed to access or perform.

Example:

Three users log in to your AI application:

| User | Allowed action |
| --- | --- |
| Admin | Manage users and view reports |
| Manager | View team reports |
| Employee | View own records |

All three users are authenticated, but their permissions are different.
